workflows.name: adr-ingest
workflows.description: Capture an architecture decision as an adr, and have the approver accept it

workflows.name: bug-ingest
workflows.description: Capture a bug and open it, then have it triaged

workflows.name: decision-log-ingest
workflows.description: Capture a decision that changes no governance, and have the approver rule it

workflows.name: governance-evolution
workflows.description: Assess, propose, approve and apply a change of the project's governance

workflows.name: retrospective-periodic
workflows.description: A retrospective of the work since the previous one

workflows.name: service-ingest
workflows.description: Record a single external service (account, credential by reference, listing, setting, domain, handle) into Memory.

workflows.name: sw-life-cycle
workflows.description: Inception, specification, delivery and end of life of a software project
